assets.description: Runtime assets (flash0 PGF fonts, ppge_atlas, compat.ini, knownfuncs.ini, vfpu LUTs, shaders, lang) that must be installed to <libretro system dir>/PPSSPP/. Core checks <system>/PPSSPP/compat.ini at retro_init.

notes: PPSSPP v1.20.4 libretro core, arm64 JIT. HW render only (RETRO_HW_CONTEXT_OPENGLES2 requested by the core because Android builds define USING_GLES2; an OpenGL ES 3.x context satisfies it and PPSSPP uses ES3 features when present). retro_hw_render_callback: depth=true, stencil=false, bottom_left_origin=true, cache_context=false, version 0.0. Frontend must answer RETRO_ENVIRONMENT_GET_PREFERRED_HW_RENDER with RETRO_HW_CONTEXT_OPENGLES3 (or not implement it): the core only accepts DUMMY/OPENGL/OPENGLES3 as 'preferred' for its GL path; OPENGLES2 as the answer would skip GL and fall through to Vulkan, then software. Vulkan (RETRO_HW_CONTEXT_VULKAN 1.0.18) is also selectable via core option ppsspp_backend=vulkan; software rendering via ppsspp_backend=none + ppsspp_software_rendering=enabled. Pixel format XRGB8888. Runs the GL emulation on a separate emu thread (useEmuThread for GLES). No BIOS. Needs cores/ppsspp/assets installed as <system_dir>/PPSSPP/. Saves/memstick go to the libretro save directory (PSP/SAVEDATA etc.). retro_get_system_info valid_extensions is 'elf|iso|cso|prx|pbp|chd' (need_fullpath=true); .zip is still accepted here because the core's loader (Core/Loaders.cpp ZipFileLoader) opens a .zip that contains an ISO/CSO directly - do not extract, pass the full path.
